scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ncc
scripts.build:ncc: npx ncc build server.js -o dist && rm -rf dist/server.conf dist/public
scripts.build:pkg: npm run build:ncc && npx pkg dist/index.js -o fivemin --targets node24-linux-x64,node24-win-x64,node24-macos-arm64 --no-bytecode --public-packages=* --public
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist fivemin-linux-x64 fivemin-macos-arm64 fivemin-win-x64.exe && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name '*.log' -delete
